tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send a project brief (app, web or interactive installation) to Lunar Creative/Technology, a creative technology studio, to request a tailored quote. Returns the indicative price range and suggested ongoing services, and the team follows up by email, usually within two working days. Use estimate_quot

tools.name: estimate_quote
tools.description: Get an indicative price range and suggested ongoing services (hosting, maintenance) for an app, web or interactive installation project by Lunar Creative/Technology, from the same questions as its quote request. Nothing is sent to the studio; answer as many questions as are known. Use request_quote

tools.name: contact_studio
tools.description: Send a general message or idea to Lunar Creative/Technology, a creative technology studio. A person replies by email. This sends a real enquiry to real people: only call it on the user’s behalf, with details the user provided (never invented), after they confirmed what will be sent.

tools.name: headless_wordpress_enquiry
tools.description: Ask Lunar Creative/Technology to review an existing WordPress website for a move to headless WordPress (faster, more secure front-end), keeping or redesigning the current design.
